title: Proof collaboration-server closed HTTP and transport operation registry

applicationProblemCodeArray.description: Exact post-Allow failure vocabulary shared with RemoteApplicationConsequenceV1; each row narrows this global closed set.

effectDigestRule.description: Exact post-success application_effect_digest contract. none requires a null consequence effect; the other mode fixes BLAKE3-256 derive-key over the selected RFC 8785 preimage and context. effect_timestamp_field is null except for a remote-authority-record effect, where it selects the exact persisted timestamp member used to order the following consequence.

const.authority_registry_resolution: exact operation name+version row from proof.dev/authority-operation-registry/v1
const.array_rule: copy every accepted AuthorizationDecisionV2 requested_resources array exactly after its required canonical ordering and uniqueness checks; workspace_ids is the singleton command Workspace; no field may be dropped, added, coarsened, or reinterpreted

const.rule: name equals registry binding_name; value is the exact typed public-safe projection; null only for declared nullable value_type

const.bindings: UTF-8 name-sorted exact {name,value_digest} array; value_digest is the binding digest above; no raw private OIDC issuer, subject, blind, token, or provider diagnostic
